hooks.name: Validate Code Before Commit
hooks.description: Validates that only one CSS and one JS file exists before allowing commits

action.command: powershell -Command "$cssFiles = (Get-ChildItem -Path css -Filter *.css -File).Count; $jsFiles = (Get-ChildItem -Path js -Filter *.js -File).Count; if ($cssFiles -ne 1 -or $jsFiles -ne 1) { Write-Error 'Error: Must have exactly 1 CSS file and 1 JS file'; exit 2 } else { Write-Output 'Validation passed: File structure is correct'; exit 0 }"
